title: Seedance 2.5 API opens as Western platforms line up to carry it
summary: ByteDance switched on public API access for its 30-second video model; Runway shipped it to users the same day, with Krea, Lovart, Pika and others announcing integrations still rolling out.
body:
## From demo to distribution

ByteDance opened public API access to Seedance 2.5 on 7 August, and Western creative platforms moved on it within hours. Runway announced first and is the integration confirmed live, offering the model to its users directly. Krea, the agentic design tool Lovart, and Pika followed within roughly ninety minutes with announcements of their own, but those integrations were still landing: Krea's own site continues to list Seedance 2.5 as coming soon while shipping Seedance 2.0 today, and Pika's newly launched API membership went live on 4 August with Seedance 2.0 among its models. Several other platforms — among them Magnific, Yapper and YouArt — have announced integrations they have yet to complete, while ByteDance's Volcano Engine and BytePlus ModelArk have been signing up developers directly. The model itself was unveiled on 31 July, but at that point it ran only inside ByteDance's own consumer apps — Jimeng and Doubao — with programmatic access listed as forthcoming. This week closed that gap.

The capability set is what makes the distribution notable. Seedance 2.5 generates up to 30 seconds of continuous audio-video in a single pass rather than stitching short clips, and it can organise multiple logically connected shots inside that span, so a sequence can carry setup, development and resolution without an editor intervening. It accepts as many as 50 reference inputs per generation — up to 30 images, 10 video clips and 10 audio clips — and supports timestamp-level editing of both picture and sound, alongside green-screen output and camera-angle adjustment.

## Pricing and positioning

Resellers list the model in the region of nine cents per second of output at lower resolutions, with token-based rates differing depending on whether video is supplied as input. That places it in direct competition with the incumbent Western video models on the same platforms that are now moving to host all of them side by side.

## Why it matters

The significant fact is not the model but the channel. A Chinese lab's flagship video model went from ByteDance-only apps to a shipping option inside a leading Western creative tool in a week, with most of the rest of that tooling layer publicly committed to following — including platforms that build their own models. Video generation is consolidating into a thin layer of interface companies buying capability wholesale, and on this cycle the wholesale supplier was ByteDance. For rivals in the US and Europe, the competitive question shifts from whose model is better to whose model is cheap and available everywhere at once. How fast the announced integrations actually go live is the thing to watch.
title_zh: Seedance 2.5 开放 API，欧美平台排队接入
summary_zh: 字节跳动正式开放这款 30 秒视频模型的公开 API：Runway 当日上线，Krea、Lovart、Pika 等平台宣布接入但仍在陆续推进。
body_zh:
## 从演示走向分发

8 月 7 日，字节跳动正式对外开放 Seedance 2.5 的公开 API，欧美创作平台数小时内接连表态。Runway 率先宣布，也是目前唯一确认已面向用户上线的接入方。约一个半小时内，Krea、智能设计工具 Lovart 与 Pika 相继宣布接入，但落地仍在推进中：Krea 官网目前仍把 Seedance 2.5 标注为「即将上线」，可用的是 Seedance 2.0；Pika 于 8 月 4 日推出的 API 会员体系，首发模型清单中同样是 Seedance 2.0。此外，Magnific、Yapper、YouArt 等平台也已宣布接入计划但尚未完成，字节的火山引擎与 BytePlus ModelArk 则在直接对接开发者。模型本身在 7 月 31 日就已亮相，但当时只能在字节自家的即梦与豆包中使用，API 一直标注为「即将开放」。这一周补上了这块拼图。

真正让这轮分发值得注意的是模型能力本身。Seedance 2.5 单次可生成最长 30 秒的连续音视频，而非把短片段拼接起来；在这 30 秒内还能组织多个逻辑连贯的镜头，让一段叙事完成铺垫、发展与收束，中途无需人工剪辑介入。单次生成最多可接受 50 个参考输入——30 张图片、10 段视频和 10 段音频，并支持对画面与声音做时间戳级别的精修，同时提供绿幕输出与机位调整。

## 定价与站位

第三方渠道给出的价格在低分辨率下约为每秒九美分量级，按 token 计费时是否带视频输入会有差别。这一定位使其与欧美现有视频模型正面竞争——而这些模型正被越来越多平台并列摆进同一份模型选单。

## 为何重要

关键不在模型，而在渠道。一个中国实验室的旗舰视频模型，一周之内就从字节自家应用走进了欧美头部创作工具的正式选项，而这一层工具中的绝大多数也已公开承诺跟进，其中还包括自研模型的平台。视频生成正在收敛为一层很薄的界面层公司加底层能力批发，而这一轮的批发商是字节跳动。对欧美同行来说，竞争问题正从「谁的模型更好」转向「谁的模型足够便宜、且到处都能调到」。接下来值得盯的，是那些已宣布的接入究竟多快真正上线。
